title: Chapter 809
text:
The group entered the Academic Affairs Building in the center of the school. The Mechanic students that followed them were not allowed to enter as they pleased. After pacing outside for a while, they slowly dispersed.

The few of them came to the dean's guest room, and the dean got a mechanical assistant to serve drinks to the guests. After inviting Han Xiao and the rest to sit down, he said, "Your Excellency Black Star, please wait for a moment. I will report your application to the upper echelons."

Han Xiao nodded and watched as the dean left. Everyone waited in the room.

Nero leaned against the window and curiously looked at the scenery of the academy. There were small floating islands floating in the sky, and there were rows upon rows of metal buildings on the ground. The outer walls were painted in yellow and blue colors, and students were riding on mechanical skateboards as they shuttled between the buildings. The red, yellow, and green forest that was planted in the academy swayed under the airwaves of the thrusters like waves in the forest. The alloy buildings and artificial greenery coexisted in harmony, forming a harmonious hue that gave off a sense of beauty that was both mechanical and natural.

"This place is so different from the Blue Star. It's so beautiful!" Nero felt that everything was new.

"This is nothing. The Imperial College on the mother planet of the Red Empire is many times more spectacular than this." Han Xiao laughed out loud. Bringing Nero out on a trip was not only to take advantage of his luck but also to broaden his horizons.

"Really? I want to take a look as well." Nero was filled with interest.

"I will bring you there in the future." Han Xiao waved his hand and called Nero back. He pointed at the drinks on the table and said, "Come and have a taste. This is good stuff."

There were a few cups of hot white liquid on the table, exuding a rich milky aroma. It was some kind of milk product specially provided by the Tyla Civilization. As the liquid swayed, it shone with a faint golden light, as if the sun was shining on a milk river at dusk.

Nero took a sip, and his eyes widened. He then raised his head and gulped down a large mouthful before letting out a sigh of relief. He licked the white stains on his lips with a look of unsatisfied.

"Is it good? If it's good, it's good milk."

"Godfather, what is this? I've never drunk such delicious milk before."

Han Xiao explained with a smile, "When the Tyla civilization was exploring a certain colonial planet, they discovered an interstellar creature that was on the brink of extinction in the universe. It was called the Helleboril Beast, commonly known as the Nebula Behemoth. Its body was extremely huge, covering the sky and the sun. It could travel through the stars with its physical body. Some people even called it the Giant God Mount. The Nebula Beast's reproductive ability is extremely low. It will only mate every hundred years or so. After giving birth to a cub, it will enter a three-month lactation period. After three months, the cub will be weaned. It is only during the lactation period that the Nebula Beast will produce milk. It is rare and precious, has a unique flavor, and is very nourishing. What you are drinking is their milk.

"So that's the case." Nero rubbed his stomach. "No wonder my body feels so warm after drinking it."

"Do you still want to drink? Drink mine." Han Xiao smiled.

Nero licked his lips. He was a little craving for it, but after some internal struggle, he shook his head. "You can't let me finish such a precious thing. Godfather should drink it too."

Hearing this, the few of them laughed.

"I won't drink it." Han Xiao waved his hand. Luxuries that were extremely precious to ordinary galactic residents were nothing in his eyes. He would always have them if he wanted them.

However, he was not interested in luxurious consumables. With this extra money, he might as well buy a few more portions of special nutrition paste. This was what he liked. It was convenient to eat, and his stamina recovered quickly. It was extremely cost-effective.

After chatting for a while, the director still had not returned. Han Xiao turned around and looked at the mechanical assistant leaning against the wall.

"How may I be of service?" The mechanical assistant sensed his gaze and immediately responded.

Han Xiao waved his hand and observed the mechanical assistant's bionic skin.

Needless to say, this director looked like he was in his seventies or eighties. The bionic skin that he gave the mechanical assistant was extremely attractive. It probably really had all the functions of a 'secretary' …

After waiting for a while, the director pushed the door open and entered. He had finally returned.

"Apologies for making everyone wait, Your Excellency Black Star. The higher-ups have agreed to your request and allowed me to use my authority to help you search for the data."

"Okay, thank the upper echelons of the Tyla Civilization for me." Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. Things were much easier now that he could solve the problem with his face.

He could not help but think of the time when the Star System Civilizations did not give him face, and he had to ask for help. Now, the Beyond Grade A Face Fruit was much more powerful, and even the Star Cluster Civilizations were willing to give him face.

The director pressed a few buttons on the table, and the color of the table changed. It immediately turned into the operation screen of the internal database. He looked up and asked, "Your Excellency Black Star, do you still remember the time and location of the data?"

Han Xiao nodded and explained. The director immediately entered the relevant parameters and ran the search system to find the relevant data.

Although he had agreed to help, he naturally would not let a Beyond Grade A Mechanic operate the internal database so easily. The director still did it for him.

Countless items appeared on the screen. After scrolling for a while, there was only one item left on the screen, which completely matched the search parameters.

The director exhaled and said, "Found it. It seems like Harrofal uploaded the files in the past. The time and location are correct. See if it's the data you want."

Han Xiao came over and looked through it carefully. Although he did not specialize in wormholes like Harrofal, he had the relevant professional knowledge and could understand the coordinates. However, this set of coordinates was not in the star map of the explored universe, and the parameters were very complicated. Without referring to the star map, he could not see anything from the data. He would only know where it led after some research.

"EsGod is so concerned about this set of data. I wonder where his doppelganger was thrown to back then …" Han Xiaoxin thought.

After confirming that this set of data was the time when Harrofal banished EsGod, Han Xiao blinked his eyes, instantly took a few hundred photos, and sent them to Philip's database. He then nodded to the director.

"Looks like my luck is not bad. I've already made a backup. Thank you very much this time."

The director turned off the screen and let it return to the desktop. He smiled and said, "As long as you're satisfied. I have something to ask of you."

Han Xiao was not surprised at all. The Tyla Civilization naturally planned to trade something from him and would not help for free.

"If it's within my ability, I will help."

"Sigh, you misunderstood. We just want to hire you as an honorary professor of the official Tyla Mechanical College in the name of the school."

It's that simple? Han Xiao was a little surprised. He thought about it and immediately understood.

As the only Beyond Grade A Mechanic in the Shattered Star Ring, if he became a professor of the official Tyla Mechanical College, this college would become famous, and the recruitment attraction would skyrocket. Many Mechanic students would apply for the college based on his name, providing more talents for the Tyla Civilization. Furthermore, if he became a professor of an official college, it would also represent a certain stance. The Tyla Civilization would definitely not lose out.

The other party had just helped him, so Han Xiao would not reject such a small request. He nodded and said, "I agree."

The director's face lit up. "Then I'll get someone to deal with it immediately. By the way, you're an honorary professor of the school. I hope you can hold a lecture here tomorrow or the day after. It won't take up too much of your time. If you don't have any objections, I'll get someone to publicize it in the school."

"Okay, then I'll disturb you guys for a few more days."

As soon as he said that, Han Xiao thought about it and suddenly said, "By the way, since I've become a professor of the school, can you give me a copy of the basic and advanced courses of your school?"

The courses of this official college were carefully written, and the basic teaching materials were very useful to the faction. They could be used to systematically cultivate the Mechanic class Supers of the army.

Although some high-grade Supers were strong individually, they were not necessarily good at teaching. For example, Ray 'Force-Feeding' Nader was one of them. The current Mechanic course of the army could basically be summarized as from beginner to grave, from advancement to coffin. The players did not care, but the ordinary recruits were much more miserable.

Since he had become an honorary professor of the school, Han Xiao might as well take some benefits.

…

The next day, the Tyla Civilization announced that they had successfully hired Black Star as an honorary professor of the official Mechanic School and contacted a bunch of galactic media outlets to spread this news.

Currently, many civilizations in the Shattered Star Ring were business allies of the Black Star Corps, and becoming an honorary professor of the official Mechanic School was even more important than business. The first to receive the news were the few Star Cluster civilizations in the Shattered Star Ring. They were all shocked and surprised. Why would Black Star suddenly be on the same side as the Tyla Civilization?

The Amethyst Civilization was even more shocked. Forget about sleeping with the thief of the Red Empire. We can't afford to offend them, but you're actually flirting with that shameless neighbor of ours. Do you still have me in your eyes, your first … ahem, your first ally who invested the most in your alliance?

After being bombarded by Ralph's phone calls, Han Xiao finally managed to calm the other party down.

This news also caused a huge commotion in the official Mechanic School of Tyla. Countless students were shocked.

Black Star is our honorary professor, and he's going to give a lecture?

How did that perverted dean convince Black Star?

Countless students were moved. They felt extremely honored and their faces were shining.

Originally, the lecture was arranged to be held in the school building, but there were simply too many students who came to listen. In the end, the school decided to hold Han Xiao's lecture in the central square.

On the day of the lecture, the venue was filled with people, and there were not enough seats. Countless students stood on mechanical skateboards in the air to listen to the lecture. More than ninety percent of the people in the school were there.

Most of the teachers, instructors, and professors also came to listen. In front of a Beyond Grade A Mechanic, they were also students.

Han Xiao stood on a temporary platform in the middle of the square. He looked around and smiled bitterly in his heart.

He had thought that he was only going to impart his experience to a small group of students. He did not expect the school to make such a big scene. Not only were there so many people watching, but there were also many recording devices on the side, recording his every move. It was like a concert, or even a lecture.

It was impossible for him to have stage fright. Back then, he did not even mind fighting with Heber in front of trillions of galactic residents. Giving a lecture now would not change his mentality at all. With his Beyond Grade A standard, any lecture would be enough to satisfy these students.

However, Han Xiao felt that he was not used to such a scene. Currently, the one who focused on lecturing was that old man Austin.

"Cough cough, let's begin then …" Han Xiao cleared his throat and began speaking.

…

"Black Star went to give a public lecture to the official school of a Star Cluster civilization? He's going to the Flickering World soon, and he still has the time to do this? "

In the Bloodshed Land headquarters, Heber was confused and could not understand what was going on.

"This kid, is he trying to copy me and create an organization like the Machinery Hermit Order?"

In the Palace of Hidden Spells, Austin had a strange expression.

"Tsk, I hate Mechanics."

On the Star Pupil mother planet of the Protoss race, Sisko turned off the screen without saying a word. He did not want to see Han Xiao at all. Every time he saw the Evolution Cube on Han Xiao's neck, his heart would ache …

"Yo, this guy is starting again?"

In the Red Empire embassy, Zoel shook his head and laughed. The way he saw it, Han Xiao was not satisfied with the current situation and had gone to form an alliance with another Star Cluster civilization.

He was happy to see this. As long as it did not affect his official business, Zoel could not wait for the dynasty's allies to have more influence in a Star Field.

As for the players who were playing together in the Black Star Army headquarters, some of them discovered the broadcast in the galactic channel, and it spread like wildfire. Very soon, it spread among the players, and more and more players turned on their communicators to watch Han Xiao's lecture.

"That's weird. I thought the Army Commander had been staying in the headquarters. Who would have thought that after not seeing him for a few days, he would go to another civilization?"

"What is he talking about? Why can't I understand him at all?"

Just as the players were watching curiously, all of a sudden, the Mechanic players were all shocked. A notification appeared on their interface.

You are listening to Black Star (Lv:?). Talking about the knowledge of the Mechanic class. Because the gap is too large, an INT and LUK Judgment has been made … Judgment has ended. You seem to understand it. One of your random Mechanic class skills has received 50,000 EXP.

You are listening to Black Star (Lv:?). Talking about the knowledge of the Mechanic class. Because the gap is too large, an INT and LUK Judgment has been made … Judgment has ended. You seem to be in deep thought. Two of your random Mechanic class skills have received 12,000 EXP.

…

You are listening to Black Star (Lv:?). Talking about the knowledge of the Mechanic class … Judgment has ended. You have an epiphany. Four of your random Mechanic class skills have received 350,000 EXP.

All the Mechanic players who were watching the broadcast were shocked.

"This is … Skill EXP?"

The Mechanic class players were overjoyed.

This was the kind of notification that NPCs would give when they taught skills or EXP to the players. However, it was very rare to encounter a random skill EXP increase. The Mechanic players did not expect that they would trigger such a good thing when they came to watch the broadcast out of curiosity.

Very soon, the news was exposed on the forums and spread to the ears of all the Mechanic players like a hurricane. They were extremely surprised and started to watch the broadcast.

"Holy sh * t, my Mechanic class skills have leveled up!"

"This must be a random event!"

"This is much faster than me doing missions … Holy sh * t, my [Intermediate Machinery Affinity] is now level 9. I'm only one level away from max!"

"As long as the Army Commander is awesome!"

Leveling up skills had always been a bottomless pit that consumed EXP. The Mechanic players were practically celebrating.

The players of the other four classes could only be envious and jealous. They could only watch as the Mechanic players encountered random events and earned a lot of EXP.

It had been a very long time since Han Xiao personally taught skills to the players. Because they did not interact much with him, many players had gradually forgotten about his past. However, this accident coincidentally made countless players suddenly remember his identity as a teacher.

His image in the hearts of the players was instantly solidified. He was recognized as the top teacher of the Mechanic class!
